_comment: OPERATOR-OWNED. Providers and model patterns the operator has turned off. They stay off until the operator removes them from this file. Every config writer honors it: ADA scripts/bifrost_model_sync.py never adds a matching model, bifrost/auth_autoheal.py only parks, and scripts/gate.py fails if bifrost/config.json contains a disabled provider or a model matching a pattern. Patterns are case-insensitive substrings matched against the model id and alias names. Operator order 2026-09-25: remove Kimi and Mistral everywhere; disable every provider without a working key until re-enabled.
